programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - The Nightmare Before Pastry
programme.desc: S25E16 - Katie Lee and Zac Young want to scare up a victory, but Bobby Flay isn't giving up without a fright; pastry chefs Michael McGowan and Kareem Queeman have a scream at the spooky star ingredient. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Halloween Wars - Back from the Dead: Things That Go Buzz in the Night
programme.desc: S16E2 - Jonathan Bennett challenges the teams to create terrifying insect-infested showpieces and daring buzz-worthy desserts inspired by coffee, tea and spirits; after an unexpected twist, judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller execute an elimination. (Cooking, Competition reality, Holiday)

programme.title: Kids Baking Championship - Trick or Eat
programme.desc: Duff and Maneet Chauhan challenge four fan favorites to create a Halloween mask pie using ingredients the bakers collect while trick-or-treating, but there is a sudden and shocking twist. (Holiday, Cooking, Competition reality)

programme.title: Halloween Wars - Back from the Dead: Things That Go Buzz in the Night: Part 1 (New)
programme.desc: Cake decorators, candy-makers and pumpkin carvers team up to compete to see who can make the biggest, wildest, and spookiest edible Halloween creations in an attempt to win a cash prize. (Cooking, Competition reality, Holiday)

programme.title: Get A Beautiful New Smile in 24 Hours
programme.desc: The Wellness Hour: Dr. Alvarez explores how Nuvia delivers a beautiful new smile in just 24 hours. (Consumer)

programme.title: Bathroom Makeover
programme.desc: Transform your bath affordably in just one day! (Consumer, Health, House/garden, Self improvement)

programme.title: Wounded Warrior Project: No Warrior is Left Behind
programme.desc: Wounded Warrior Project is changing the way our nation cares for veterans and helping them thrive for a lifetime. Join Trace Adkins and Dan Nevins to learn about the journeys of four injured veterans and how no warrior is left behind. (Consumer)

programme.title: Paid Programming
programme.desc: Paid programming. (Consumer, Shopping, Variety)

programme.title: Worst Cooks in America - Talented & Terrible: Boot Camp's Got Talent
programme.desc: S29E1 - Chefs Anne Burrell and Gabe Bertaccini have just seven weeks to turn a talented bunch of culinary train wrecks into kitchen stars; the recruits kick things off with their signature showstopper dish and then tackle making a chicken dinner. (Cooking, Competition reality)

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman - Foolproof Fallbacks
programme.desc: S31E9 - Ree Drummond whips up dishes that can't go wrong, including chocolate sheet cake with vanilla bean frosting, stuffed peppers, simple Tex-Mex chicken spaghetti, and whiskey pot roast. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman - Fresh and Fast
programme.desc: S34E1 - Ree Drummond puts a fresh spin on dinner with a one-pan chicken cauliflower skillet, saucy rustic turkey meatball pasta and an extra-fast orange ginger steak stir-fry; she also cooks grilled pita pizzas piled high with vegetables for a solo supper. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman - Countertop Cooking
programme.desc: S39E12 - Ree Drummond is cooking on the countertop; she puts together a speedy all-in-one sausage and potato soup in the pressure cooker; then, the air fryer is perfect for a fast BBQ chicken bagel pizza; the microwave serves up a quick brownie bowl. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman - More Cheese Please
programme.desc: S40E9 - Ree Drummond is getting cheesy; Mascarpone Cheesecake Bars get a cheery cherry topping; Oaxaca cheese and sharp cheddar elevate Cheese Enchiladas, Pepper Jack and Colby Jack team up in Beer Cheese for 2 and more. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: The Kitchen - Fall for Your Pantry
programme.desc: S26E6 - Seasonal dishes using pantry staples; chicken bolognese; popovers with sesame butter and spiced pear jam; German-style sweet potato salad; lentil salad with mushrooms and pink lady apples; spicy bean dip. (Cooking)

programme.title: The Kitchen - The Kitchen's Brunch in Bed
programme.desc: S32E11 - The ultimate cozy brunch menu; Geoffrey Zakarian whips classic Belgian waffles; Katie Lee Biegel shares her indulgent everything bagel cream cheese rolls; Sunny Anderson serves up a brown sugar cold brew. (Cooking)

programme.title: Last Bite Hotel - Fire and Ice
programme.desc: S1E4 - Tituss Burgess welcomes VIP guests Esther Choi and Judy Joo, who request something spicy for dinner from the remaining four chefs; the chefs must use even more of their precious resources to make something icy cool for the guests. (Cooking, Competition reality)

programme.title: Last Bite Hotel - A Midnight Check-In
programme.desc: S1E5 - There are only three chefs remaining as host Tituss Burgess welcomes VIP guest Andrew Zimmern for a late check-in; the competitors make a midnight snack, and in the morning, they use their dwindling ingredients to create stunning breakfast dishes. (Cooking, Competition reality)

programme.title: Last Bite Hotel - The Last Bite
programme.desc: S1E6 - Tituss Burgess welcomes three VIP guests, Iron Chefs Alex Guarnaschelli, Cat Cora and Jose Garces to the hotel; the final competitors must impress the guests with a three-course meal to win the grand prize of 25,000 dollars. (Cooking, Competition reality)

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - Bottoms Up, Bobby Down!
programme.desc: S33E9 - Actress, comedian and foodie Aisha Tyler and Katie Lee Biegel get crafty. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - The Bald and the Beautiful
programme.desc: S33E7 - Supermodel and swimwear designer Devon Windsor teams up with Chef Michael Symon to keep the drama high while chefs Dom Crisp and Santiago Guzzetti try to cook up a win against Bobby Flay. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - Red Carpet Ready
programme.desc: S36E10 - Chef Katie Lee Biegel and fashion icon Carson Kressley glam it up; chefs Rob Reinsmith and Manny Barella dress Bobby Flay down. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - Sweet Defeat
programme.desc: S35E11 - Duff Goldman and actress Alyson Hannigan join forces with pastry pros Jewel Johnson and Katherine Sprung to take down Bobby Flay. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - From Plies to Plating
programme.desc: S37E2 - Andrew Zimmern and Misty Copeland dance circles around Bobby Flay as chefs Tristen Epps and Vinnie Cimino make sure their plates are on point. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - Bad News for Bobby

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - Oh, Crepe!

programme.title: MLB Central (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Now (Live)

The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls. (Baseball)

programme.title: Everybody Wants Some!!
programme.desc: In 1980 Texas, a college freshman meets his new baseball teammates, an unruly group of disco-dancing, skirt-chasing partiers. - Will Brittain, Zoey Deutch, Ryan Guzman, Tyler Hoechlin, Blake Jenner (Comedy)

programme.title: Road Trip
programme.desc: Josh (Breckin Meyer) videotapes his affair with another girl and accidentally mails it to his girlfriend. Discovering the mistake, he tows two of his college buddies -- and one not-so-eager kid who happens to own the car -- on a raucous 1,800-mile road trip from Ithaca, N.Y., to Austin, Texas, to save his lifelong romance. - Seann William Scott, Breckin Meyer, D.J. Qualls, Fred Ward, Andy Dick (Comedy)

programme.title: The Argument
programme.desc: When a couple argue about a party and neither will back down, they decide to re-create the evening to determine who is right. - Dan Fogler, Maggie Q, Danny Pudi, Emma Bell, Tyler James Williams (Comedy)

programme.title: Justin Bieber: Never Say Never
programme.desc: A young singing sensation prepares to dazzle the crowd at a sold-out show at Madison Square Garden. Legions of adoring Bieber fans scream as he takes center stage for a memorable night of music. Concert footage mixes with home videos of Justin playing drums and showcasing his talent. - Boyz II Men (Documentary)

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The four nations of Air, Water, Earth and Fire lived in harmony until the Fire Nation declared war. A century later, there is still no end in sight to the destruction, then, an Avatar named Aang (Noah Ringer) discovers that he has the power to control the four elements. He joins forces with Katara (Nicola Peltz), a Waterbender, and her brother, Sokka, to restore balance and harmony to their world. - Noah Ringer, Dev Patel, Nicola Peltz, Jackson Rathbone, Shaun Toub (Fantasy, Adventure)

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps. - Garrett Hedlund, Hamish Linklater, Brittany Snow, Christian Convery, Tramell Tillman (Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Love Me
programme.desc: A buoy and a satellite meet online long after humanity's extinction. As they learn what life was like on Earth, they discover themselves and what it means to be alive and in love. - Kristen Stewart, Steven Yeun (Romance, Science fiction, Drama)

programme.title: Old Guy
programme.desc: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights. - Christoph Waltz, Lucy Liu, Cooper Hoffman, Ryan McParland, Ann Akinjirin (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Run
programme.desc: Smugglers, the police, locals and tourists get drawn into a dangerous web of survival, sacrifice and shifting loyalties as Europe faces a surge in migration. - Amanda Plummer, Ulrich Thomsen, Costas Mandylor, James Russo, Barkhad Abdi (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Vicious
programme.desc: Polly receives a mysterious box that comes with instructions to place three things inside: something you need, something you hate, and something you love. What begins as a strange ritual quickly unravels into a waking nightmare as she becomes trapped in a terrifying world where reality bends and memory betrays. As time slips away, she must confront the darkness not just around her, but within her, before it consumes everything and everyone she's ever known. - Dakota Fanning, Kathryn Hunter, Mary McCormack, Rachel Blanchard, Devyn Nekoda (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Tales From the Darkside: The Movie
programme.desc: The first of three dark tales involves resentful student Bellingham (Steve Buscemi) looking to an Egyptian mummy for help in settling some scores. Then, hit man Halston (David Johansen) is contracted to kill a cat that has terrorized and even killed members of an extremely wealthy family. Lastly, struggling artist Preston (James Remar) witnesses a demon commit a bizarre murder on a city street, but agrees to keep it a secret when the devilish being promises wealth in return for his silence. - Deborah Harry, Christian Slater, David Johansen, William Hickey, James Remar (Horror)

programme.title: South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
programme.desc: In this feature film based on the hit animated series, the third-graders of South Park sneak into an R-rated film by ultra-vulgar Canadian television personalities Terrance (Matt Stone) and Phillip (Trey Parker), and emerge with expanded vocabularies that leave their parents and teachers scandalized. When outraged Americans try to censor the film, the controversy becomes a call to war with Canada, and Terrance and Phillip end up on death row -- with only the kids left to save them. (Animated, Comedy)

programme.title: Jackass: The Movie
programme.desc: In this comedic documentary, Johnny Knoxville heads a crew of stuntmen, skateboarders and all-around lunatics as they prank, embarrass and torture each other in the name of fun. The antics range from childlike -- the boys don panda suits for a romp through Tokyo -- to grotesque and life-threatening. A golf cart demolition derby turns downright dangerous. Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly. (Comedy, Docudrama)

programme.title: Jackass: Number Two
programme.desc: Johnny Knoxville and his band of merry maniacs go on another madcap series of adventures involving outrageous stunts and downright craziness. With Bam Margera and Steve-O.

programme.title: Jackass 3
programme.desc: Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O and their fearless and foolhardy friends perform outrageous pranks and stunts, including "Sweatsuit Cocktail" and "Beehive Tetherball."

programme.title: Fight or Flight
programme.desc: A mercenary takes on the job of tracking a high-value asset known only as "The Ghost" on an international flight. Realizing the plane is filled with assassins assigned to kill them both, the pair must work together in a fight for their lives.

programme.title: Winter Spring Summer or Fall
programme.desc: Young Remi has her future figured out, until she meets Barnes, who lives for the moment and makes her question everything. As their love story unfolds, she faces a choice -- stick to her plan or risk it all for a life she never saw coming.

programme.title: Citizen Bio
programme.desc: Exploring in depth the nascent biohacking movement and the unconventional scientists and researchers developing alternative medicines to prolong human life and eradicate incurable viruses and diseases.

programme.title: Some Kind of Wonderful
programme.desc: A grease monkey's (Eric Stoltz) tomboy friend (Mary Stuart Masterson) helps him woo a popular girl (Lea Thompson) in their Los Angeles high school.

programme.title: War Pony
programme.desc: The interlocking stories of two young Oglala Lakota men grappling with a world built against them as they navigate their unique paths to manhood.

programme.title: The Cut
programme.desc: Given one last shot at glory, a former boxing champion has just six days to make weight for a title fight. His obsession soon leaves him at the mercy of a notorious trainer who takes every last ounce from his mind, body and soul.

programme.title: Personal Shopper
programme.desc: A young American in Paris works as a personal shopper for a celebrity. She seems to have the ability to communicate with spirits, like her recently deceased twin brother. Soon, she starts to receive ambiguous messages from an unknown source.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: A young couple (Katie Featherston, Micah Sloat) move into their first new home but are disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence that is most active at night.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: An aspiring teenage rock journalist gets his big break when he follows an up-and-coming band on its tour.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: The owner (Vince Vaughn) of a gym and an overbearing entrepreneur (Ben Stiller) form dodgeball teams to compete for $50,000 in Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Perfect Score
programme.desc: High-school students (Erika Christensen, Chris Evans, Bryan Greenberg) conspire to steal the answers to their upcoming SATs.

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: A scholarship student (Brendan Fraser) hides his Jewish heritage to fit in at an Eastern prep school in the mid-1950s.

programme.title: Bleed for This
programme.desc: Vinny "The Pazmanian Devil" Pazienza (Miles Teller), a local Providence boxer, shoots to stardom after winning two world title fights. After a near-fatal car accident leaves him with a broken neck, he is told he may never walk again. Against all odds and doctor's orders, renowned trainer Kevin Rooney (Aaron Eckhart) agrees to help Vinny return to the ring just a year after the accident for what could be the last fight of his life. Based on a true story. - Miles Teller, Aaron Eckhart, Katey Sagal, Ciarán Hinds, Ted Levine (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: Super
programme.desc: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante. - Rainn Wilson, Elliot Page, Liv Tyler, Kevin Bacon, Nathan Fillion (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
programme.desc: Breaking up with Mark Darcy (Colin Firth) leaves Bridget Jones (Renée Zellweger) over 40 and single again. Feeling that she has everything under control, Jones decides to focus on her career as a top news producer. Suddenly, her love life comes back from the dead when she meets a dashing and handsome American named Jack (Patrick Dempsey). Things couldn't be better, until Bridget discovers that she is pregnant. Now, the befuddled mom-to-be must figure out if the proud papa is Mark or Jack. - Renée Zellweger, Colin Firth, Patrick Dempsey, Emma Thompson, Shirley Henderson (Romantic comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Case 39
programme.desc: In her many years as a social worker, Emily Jenkins (Renée Zellweger) thinks she has seen it all -- until she meets 10-year-old Lilith (Jodelle Ferland) and the girl's cruel parents. When the parents try to harm the child, Emily assumes custody of Lilith while looking for a foster family. However, she soon finds that dark forces surround the seemingly innocent child, and the more she tries to protect Lilith, the more horrors she encounters. - Renée Zellweger, Jodelle Ferland, Ian McShane, Bradley Cooper, Kerry O'Malley (Horror, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Asylum
programme.desc: An administrator's bored wife (Natasha Richardson) begins a torrid affair with an institutionalized artist (Marton Csokas) who beat his wife to death. - Natasha Richardson, Ian McKellen, Marton Csokas, Hugh Bonneville, Judy Parfitt (Drama)

programme.title: House at the End of the Street
programme.desc: In search of a fresh start, divorcee Sarah (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter, Elissa (Max Thieriot), find their dream house in a small town. But when startling, unexplainable events begin, the pair learn that a chilling secret holds the town in its grip. Years earlier a girl killed her parents and disappeared, leaving a brother, Ryan (Max Thieriot), as the sole survivor. Elissa begins a relationship with Ryan, and the closer they get, the deeper they're all pulled into a dangerous mystery. - Jennifer Lawrence, Max Thieriot, Elisabeth Shue, Gil Bellows, Eva Link (Thriller, Horror)

programme.title: The Uninvited
programme.desc: After spending time in a psychiatric facility, young Anna (Emily Browning) finds significant changes in store at home. Her widowed father (David Strathairn) is now engaged to her mother's former nurse, Rachel (Elizabeth Banks). One night, the ghost of Anna's mother appears, screaming for revenge and accusing Rachel of murder. Anna and her sister, Alex (Arielle Kebbel), start to investigate, but they may be unprepared for the lethal battle of wills that ensues. - Elizabeth Banks, Emily Browning, Arielle Kebbel, David Strathairn, Jesse Moss (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery)

programme.title: I Used to Go Here
programme.desc: A successful author finds herself deeply enmeshed in the lives of a group of college students after being asked to speak at her alma mater. - Gillian Jacobs, Jemaine Clement, Josh Wiggins, Forrest Goodluck, Khloe Janel (Comedy)

programme.title: Just Go With It
programme.desc: His heart recently broken, plastic surgeon Danny Maccabee (Adam Sandler) pretends to be married so he can enjoy future dates with no strings attached. His web of lies works, but when he meets Palmer (Brooklyn Decker) -- the gal of his dreams -- she resists involvement. Instead of coming clean, Danny enlists Katherine (Jennifer Aniston), his assistant, to pose as his soon-to-be-ex-wife. Instead of solving Danny's problems, the lies create more trouble. - Adam Sandler, Jennifer Aniston, Nicole Kidman, Nick Swardson, Brooklyn Decker (Romantic comedy, Comedy)

programme.title: Comet
programme.desc: A cynical lad (Justin Long) and a young woman (Emmy Rossum) begin a 6-year relationship after meeting by chance during a meteor shower. - Justin Long, Emmy Rossum, Eric Winter, Kayla Servi, Ben Pace (Romance, Comedy drama)

programme.title: Jenny's Wedding
programme.desc: When Jenny (Katherine Heigl) decides to marry a woman (Alexis Bledel), her conventional family must accept who she is or risk losing her forever. - Katherine Heigl, Tom Wilkinson, Linda Emond, Grace Gummer, Alexis Bledel (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ, Drama)

programme.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
programme.desc: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit. - Mila Kunis, Kristen Bell, Kathryn Hahn, Cheryl Hines, Christine Baranski (Holiday, Comedy)

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: David (Woody Harrelson) and Diana Murphy (Demi Moore) are a loving couple with a bright future. David is a talented architect; Diana is a top-notch real estate agent. But when the recession hits, their finances take a nosedive. In a last-ditch effort to save their dream home, they head to Las Vegas to win their mortgage money gambling. After they lose everything, a mysterious billionaire (Robert Redford) offers the solution to their money problems: $1 million -- if he can sleep with Diana. - Robert Redford, Demi Moore, Woody Harrelson, Oliver Platt, Seymour Cassel (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: After an outlaw named Tom Chaney murders her father, feisty 14-year-old farm girl Mattie Ross hires Rooster Cogburn, a boozy, trigger-happy lawman, to help her find Chaney and avenge her father. The bickering duo are not alone in their quest, for a Texas Ranger named LaBoeuf is also tracking Chaney for reasons of his own. Together the unlikely trio ventures into hostile territory to dispense some Old West justice. - Jeff Bridges, Matt Damon, Josh Brolin, Barry Pepper, Hailee Steinfeld (Western, Drama, Adventure)

programme.title: Dead Man Walking
programme.desc: As death row inmate Matthew Poncelet (Sean Penn) nears his execution date, he calls upon Sister Helen Prejean (Susan Sarandon) to help him with one last appeal, maintaining that he is innocent of the murders of a young couple. Poncelet begins to form a bond with Prejean, and she visits both his family and the relatives of the victims, hoping to learn more about the case. As things begin to look bleak for Poncelet, Prejean does all that she can to comfort and console the hardened convict. - Susan Sarandon, Sean Penn, Robert Prosky, Raymond J. Barry, R. Lee Ermey (Crime drama)

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: A deep bond develops between a cantankerous trainer (Clint Eastwood) and the female boxer (Hilary Swank) he reluctantly takes under his wing.

programme.title: Frida
programme.desc: Mexican painter Frida Kahlo (Salma Hayek) marries fellow artist Diego Rivera who shares her radical political views.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: A New York lawyer (Michael Douglas) with a wife (Anne Archer) and daughter sleeps with a client (Glenn Close) whose lust turns to hate.

programme.title: Just Go With It
programme.desc: A plastic surgeon (Adam Sandler) enlists the aid of his assistant (Jennifer Aniston) and her children to help him win the heart of a beautiful woman.

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Boutique bookseller Kathleen hates Joe, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity.

programme.title: Proof
programme.desc: A depressed woman (Gwyneth Paltrow) copes with the death of her father (Anthony Hopkins), a brilliant but mentally ill mathematician.

programme.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
programme.desc: A collection of short films showcasing different themes.

programme.title: The Haunting
programme.desc: A parapsychologist and three others stay in a house reputed to be the site of many awful tragedies and paranormal events.

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: A widowed lawyer (Daniel Radcliffe) encounters ghostly goings-on at the foreboding estate of a recently deceased client.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: A masked killer continues to pursue a California student (Neve Campbell) and her friends at an Ohio college.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: Murders draw a young woman (Neve Campbell), a reporter (Courteney Cox Arquette) and an ex-policeman (David Arquette) to the set of a movie inspired by horrific events that they survived.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Telling fortunes to support herself and her daughter, a psychic widow (Cate Blanchett) assists the police in a missing persons case.

programme.title: Ghost in the Shell
programme.desc: A one-of-a-kind, cyber-enhanced soldier (Scarlett Johansson) must battle a new enemy who can hack into people's minds and control them.

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: After enduring setbacks in her television career, executive Joanna Eberhart (Nicole Kidman) relocates with her family from New York City to the Connecticut suburb of Stepford. While Joanna's husband, Walter (Matthew Broderick), quickly warms up to their new town, she has a hard time adjusting to Stepford's manicured environs and the overly accommodating attitude of the area women. Soon Joanna begins to suspect that something is not right, and she tries to uncover Stepford's secret. - Nicole Kidman, Matthew Broderick, Bette Midler, Glenn Close, Christopher Walken (Dark comedy, Horror, Thriller, Science fiction)

programme.title: Blindness
programme.desc: When an epidemic of a disease known as the "white sickness" appears in her city, the wife (Julianne Moore) of a doctor is one of the few individuals left who still has sight. Sent to a government asylum along with her now-blind husband (Mark Ruffalo), she sees conditions deteriorate until civilization itself is in jeopardy, prompting her break-out of the asylum to lead a small group to freedom. - Julianne Moore, Mark Ruffalo, Alice Braga, Yusuke Iseya, Yoshino Kimura (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: 4:44 Last Day on Earth
programme.desc: Two lovers (Willem Dafoe, Shanyn Leigh) immerse themselves in sex, art and other activities after word breaks that the world will end by the next morning. - Willem Dafoe, Shanyn Leigh, Natasha Lyonne, Paul Hipp, Anita Pallenberg (Drama, Fantasy, Science fiction)

programme.title: The Last Exorcism Part II
programme.desc: Found terrified and alone in rural Louisiana, Nell Sweetzer is now safely in New Orleans. She can't remember the terrible events of the previous months, only that she is the only surviving member of her family. Nell wants to start a new life for herself, but just as she begins the difficult process, the evil force that once possessed her returns -- bringing with it unimaginably horrific plans that mean her last exorcism was just the beginning. - Ashley Bell, Julia Garner, Spencer Treat Clark, Louis Herthum, David Jensen (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Arthur Kipps, a lawyer, is recently widowed and grieving the loss of his wife when he is sent to a remote village to put a deceased eccentric's affairs in order. Soon after his arrival, it becomes clear that the villagers are hiding a terrible secret. Kipps discovers that his late client's house is haunted by the spirit of a woman who is trying to find someone and something she lost, and that no one -- not even the children -- is safe from her terrible wrath. - Daniel Radcliffe, Misha Handley, Roger Allam, Ciarán Hinds, Janet McTeer (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Fantasy)

programme.title: The Butcher's Wife
programme.desc: Clairvoyant Marina (Demi Moore) meets New York City butcher Leo Lemke (George Dzundza) while he is visiting her small town in North Carolina. When she then dreams about him, she believes it is a sign that he is her true love. She marries Leo and moves to his working-class neighborhood in New York City. There she meets his neighbors, including shy singer Stella (Mary Steenburgen) and psychiatrist Alex Tremor (Jeff Daniels). Soon Marina begins to wonder if she was wrong about her soul mate. - Demi Moore, Jeff Daniels, George Dzundza, Mary Steenburgen, Frances McDormand (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ)

programme.title: Duplex
programme.desc: A writer named Alex (Ben Stiller) and his girlfriend, Nancy (Drew Barrymore), move into a spacious duplex in Brooklyn, N.Y. The elderly woman (Eileen Essell) who lives on the building's top floor seems a sweet enough neighbor at first. But pretty soon her constant demands and accidents ruin Alex and Nancy's attempts at having the perfect home. Once they discover that the woman cannot be evicted, they resort to more permanent measures to get rid of her. - Ben Stiller, Drew Barrymore, Eileen Essell, Harvey Fierstein, Justin Theroux (Comedy)

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: A young man (Matthew McConaughey) continues to live at the home of parents who, in desperation to push him out of the nest once and for all, hatch a plan. They hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to assume the mantle of responsibility and get his own place. - Matthew McConaughey, Sarah Jessica Parker, Zooey Deschanel, Justin Bartha, Bradley Cooper (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Romance)

programme.title: The Lovely Bones
programme.desc: After being brutally murdered, 14-year-old Susie Salmon (Saoirse Ronan) watches from heaven over her grief-stricken family (Mark Wahlberg, Rachel Weisz) -- and her killer (Stanley Tucci). As she observes their daily lives, she must balance her thirst for revenge with her desire for her family to heal. - Mark Wahlberg, Rachel Weisz, Susan Sarandon, Stanley Tucci, Michael Imperioli (Drama, Mystery, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: The Firm
programme.desc: A young lawyer joins a small but prestigious law firm only to find out that most of their clients are on the wrong side of the law. The company is helping to launder mob money, get clients off charges and even murder partners who threaten to blow their cover, but when the FBI come calling to gather evidence on the lawyer's colleagues, he is caught between a rock and a hard place, juggling his life and his liberty. - Tom Cruise, Jeanne Tripplehorn, Gene Hackman, Holly Hunter, Ed Harris (Drama, Thriller, Mystery)

Their mission: detonate a device that will reactivate the core. - Aaron Eckhart, Hilary Swank, Delroy Lindo, Stanley Tucci, D.J. Qualls (Action, Science fiction, Adventure, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Citizen Bio
programme.desc: Exploring in depth the nascent biohacking movement and the unconventional scientists and researchers developing alternative medicines to prolong human life and eradicate incurable viruses and diseases. (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: Love and Monsters
programme.desc: Seven years after the Monsterpocalypse, Joel Dawson, along with the rest of humanity, has been living underground ever since giant creatures took control of the land. After reconnecting over the radio with his high school girlfriend, Aimee, who is now 80 miles away at a coastal colony, Joel begins to fall for her again. As Joel realizes that there's nothing left for him underground, he decides to venture out to Aimee, despite all the dangerous monsters that stand in his way. - Dylan O'Brien, Jessica Henwick, Dan Ewing, Michael Rooker, Ariana Greenblatt (Fantasy, Adventure, Comedy)

programme.title: Before Dawn
programme.desc: A young man joins his countrymen on the Western front of World War I, hoping to expedite an end to the bloody conflict. However, as the battle rages on, he's forced to grapple with the brutal realities of trench warfare, including a near-constant struggle to keep himself alive without leaving another man behind. - Levi Miller, Travis Jeffery, Myles Pollard, Tim Franklin, Jordan Dulieu (War, Historical drama)

programme.title: Chuck
programme.desc: He was the pride of Bayonne, N.J., a man who went 15 rounds in the ring with Muhammad Ali. But before all of that, Chuck Wepner was a liquor salesman and father with a modest prizefighting career whose life changed overnight when, in 1975, he was chosen to take on Ali in a highly publicized title match. It's the beginning of a wild ride through the exhilarating highs and humbling lows of sudden fame, but what happens when your 15 minutes in the spotlight are up? - Liev Schreiber, Elisabeth Moss, Naomi Watts, Ron Perlman, Jim Gaffigan (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: Guns Up
programme.desc: After a job goes horribly wrong, a man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city while keeping his dark secret hidden. - Kevin James, Christina Ricci, Luis Guzmán, Melissa Leo, Francis Cronin (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: This follow-up to the popular "Teen Titans" series takes a more comedic look at the superheroes, showing what life is like for the teens when their capes come off. Funny things happen to Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg between saving the world and being regular teens, living together without adult supervision. The teens, in their ordinary lives, deal with the everyday issues of adolescence that include such important things as having staring contests to determine who does the laundry and going on a series of quests to construct the perfect sandwich.
